answer: Let influence grow like a pearl: layer by layer, through continuous, varied activity over real time — never through a burst of work. A farm can mint a thousand identities overnight, but it cannot fast-forward their age, so its whole army stays light. And like water sinking into karst, a sold identity's history drains away at transfer: any sharp ridge in behavior, a sudden new pattern of action, resets its weight to zero. Time is the one input a sybil farmer cannot clone.
